newsitem.title: UK: London Intl to close US condom factory.
newsitem.headline: London Intl to close US condom factory.

text.p: London International Group Plc said on Thursday it is to close its condom manufacturing plant at Anderson, South Carolina and cut about 200 full time and 150 part time jobs over the next 12 months.
All manufacturing from the Anderson factory will move to LIG's plant in Alabama.

"The closure of Anderson is an important further step in LIG's continuing restructuring programme which is designed to reduce costs and maximise the Group's ability to supply global markets effectively," said LIG's chief executive Nick Hodges.
Total costs from the closure and other restructuring programmes underway in the U.S. would be fully met from the group's provisions -- which include an additional provision of eight million stg.
The group said it planned to provide comprehensive support and counselling to the operation's staff, and all employees would be talked to individually during the next few days.
